The '''Great Atrium''' was located aboard the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian Herdship|Herdship]] ''[[Tafanda Bay]]''. A [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] across, the Great Atrium had [[Moss/Legends|moss]]-covered walls.<ref name="EGVV" />
